answer: A wallet can spin dozens of fake shoppers overnight. To vote, an identity locks 38 POA and checks out one velvet swatch dyed with a registered violet lot, then has a harbor clerk stamp that lot onto two staff readings of the tide, taken at least 5.5 hours apart at separate gauges. A second clone needs its own dyed lot and two unused clerks. Peers recompute the gauge hashes from the public harbor log and reject a reused lot or overlapping clerk. A missed reading or two swatches sharing a lot burns 55% of the lock; a clerk who double-stamps in one window forfeits 11 POA.
